entries.title: Task, Knowledge and Batches commands in your language
entries.body: When Infinitary speaks a language other than English, command search and Settings → Keyboard now show the Tasks, Knowledge and Batches panels' commands, such as Find a task, Open task board, Open Knowledge and Show your batches, in that language. Command search still finds them by their English names too.

picture.alt: Command search in Arabic, listing the task board's commands in Arabic for the English word board
